evidence: the adoption of artificial intelligence ("AI") and other emerging technologies may become significant to operating results in the future, including in areas such as brokerage, dispatch, routing, pickup and delivery appointments, and other areas where automation is possible

While AI and other technologies may offer substantial benefits, they may also introduce additional risk, including those relating to errors or inaccuracies in work product developed through the use of AI and privacy, intellectual property, and legal and regulatory risks
If we are unable to successfully implement and utilize such emerging technologies as effectively and as quickly as competitors, our results of operation may be negatively affected
the use of AI by bad actors may make cyberattacks more difficult to anticipate or detect
ai_positioning.summary: KNX reconnaît le potentiel de l'IA pour ses opérations (dispatch, routage, automatisation) mais adopte une posture défensive, mettant l'accent sur les risques de mise en œuvre, la concurrence technologique et les menaces cybersécurité.
